parent_objective: design a reset-valid core panel after closing the local obstacle-filter repair branch
blocked_by: M2085 reset validation failed 2/240 attempts and M2086 pivots away from local repair
supersedes: direct measured execution on the full 240-row panel

public_gates: M2087 must design a reduced reset-valid panel route using M2085 reset-success rows
M2087 must preserve all public-gate rows unless it explicitly justifies a stricter subset
M2087 must not change obstacle filters or rerun reset
M2087 must block measured execution until reduction materialization is implemented and audited
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not treat generated rows as paper-valid tasks

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: starts the post-pivot branch by designing a reduced reset-valid core panel instead of repairing filters
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: panel-reduction design only; no reset rerun rollout driver performance mechanism ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if design would mutate obstacle filters
stop if design would drop public-gate rows without justification
stop if design would run measured execution before materialization audit
stop if design treats generated rows as paper-valid
fallback_plan: route to reduced-panel materialization implementation if design is clean
route to scenario-distribution redesign if reduced panel cannot preserve useful coverage
route to stop if no reset-valid core can be justified
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2086 pivots away from local obstacle-filter repair

admission_evidence: M2086 closes the local repair loop
blocked_shortcuts: do not run reset in design
allowed_updates: M2087 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for reduced-panel materialization or distribution redesign

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2087 designs a task panel and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2087.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If reduced-panel coverage is not useful, pivot to distribution redesign rather than weakening claim guards.
allowed_claims: no reset rerun, rollout, controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: changes branch from public-row repair to reset-valid panel definition
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can define a measured-execution-admissible core only after materialization and audit
must_synthesize_if: M2087 routes back to local obstacle-filter repair
M2087 cannot preserve all public-gate rows or document coverage loss
M2087 proposes measured execution before materialization audit

hypothesis: A reset-valid core panel can be defined from M2085 reset-success rows without further obstacle-filter repair, preserving all public-gate rows and enough coverage to justify materialization.
success_criteria: no reset rollout measured execution ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: new reset or rollout is performed

commands.name: design
commands.command: write reset-valid core panel reduction design from M2086 synthesis

decision_rule: M2087 passes if it designs a reset-valid core panel route without filter repair, reset rerun, or overclaiming.
